entities.summary:
Michael Allen Geist is a Canadian academic, and the Canada Research Chair in Internet and E-Commerce Law at the University of Ottawa. He is the editor of four books on copyright law and privacy law, 
and he edits two newsletters on Canadian information technology and privacy law.
